changed.title: Find a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit under the ranked cyclic witness negation bound
changed.statement:
∃ (n w : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (q : Fin (2 ^ n)),
  let I := n * 2 ^ (w + 1)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (outBit : Fin n → Fin (I + C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack I C ∧
    (∀ table : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      let inputs := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => List.ofFn (fun pat : Fin (2 ^ (w + 1)) =>
        table i (fun j => pat.val.testBit j.val)))).flatten
      let sols := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ n))).filter (fun z => ∀ i : Fin n,
        table i (fun j => z.val.testBit (n - 1 - ((i.val + j.val) % n))) = true)
      q.val < sols.card → ∃ z ∈ sols,
        (sols.filter (fun y => y.val < z.val)).card = q.val ∧
        ∀ pos : Fin n, (C.wires inputs).getD (outBit pos).val false =
          z.val.testBit (n - 1 - pos.val)) ∧
    ∃ k b : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ k ≤ w + 1 ∧ k + b ≤ n ∧ q.val < 2 ^ (k + b) ∧
      2 ^ PEqualNP.NotBracket.notCount C <
        1 + ((n - b) / k) * (2 ^ k - 1) - q.val / 2 ^ b

changed.title: Exact inner width and separate binary rank budgets for factoring a rectangular matrix modulo four
changed.statement:
∀ (n m w p q : ℕ) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 4)),
  let reduce := fun {a b : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) (ZMod 4)) =>
    (fun i j => ((M i j).val : ZMod 2) : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) (ZMod 2))
  let outputs := Finset.univ.image (fun x : Fin m → ZMod 4 => G.mulVec x)
  let killed := outputs.filter (fun y => ∀ i, y i + y i = 0)
  (∃ (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin w) (ZMod 4)) (V : Matrix (Fin w) (Fin m) (ZMod 4)),
    U * V = G ∧ Matrix.rank (reduce U) ≤ p ∧ Matrix.rank (reduce V) ≤ q) ↔
    Matrix.rank (reduce G) ≤ min p q ∧ outputs.card ≤ 2^(p+q) ∧ killed.card ≤ 2^w
changed.unlocks: It gives the precise binary rank obstruction carried by a product modulo four, including when its ordinary parity matrix vanishes.
changed.context: Invert unit pivots by row and column operations, then reduce the even block to twice a binary identity. With u unit and v even pivots the three invariants are u, 4^u 2^v and 2^(u+v). For a product, classify middle vectors by parity. There are at most 2^q classes, and differences within a class go to twice the left factor, with at most 2^p outputs. The image sits in the left image, whose doubling kernel has at most 2^w elements by the same normal form. Conversely split the v pivots between 1 times 2 and 2 times 1 to fit the spare ranks. Pad unused coordinates.

changed.title: Minimum numbers of raw sites and read wires for uniformly distributed binary reports
changed.statement:
let Word := fun k : Nat => Fin k → ZMod 2
let localRule := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (T : Fin n → Word n → ZMod 2) =>
  ∀ i x y, (∀ j ∈ D i, x j = y j) → T i x = T i y
let observed := fun (n m : Nat) (Q : Fin n → Word m) (U : Finset (Fin n))
    (T : Fin n → Word n → ZMod 2) (b : Word n) (z : U → ZMod 2) (r : Fin m) =>
  let x := fun i : Fin n => if h : i ∈ U then z ⟨i,h⟩ else b i
  ∑ i, (x i + T i x) * Q i r
let uniform := fun (n m : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (Q : Fin n → Word m)
    (U : Finset (Fin n)) =>
  ∀ T, localRule n D T → ∀ b v,
    2^m * Nat.card {z : U → ZMod 2 // observed n m Q U T b z = v} = 2^U.card
let readers := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) =>
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => j ∈ D i)).card
let wires := fun (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) => ∑ i, (D i).card
∀ m : Nat, 1 ≤ m →
  let N := 2^m - 1
  (∃ (D : Fin N → Finset (Fin N)) (Q : Fin N → Word m),
    (∀ i, i ∉ D i) ∧
    (∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun r => Q i r ≠ 0)).card ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ j, readers N D j = m-1) ∧ wires N D = N*(m-1) ∧
    (∀ U, uniform N m D Q U ↔ U = Finset.univ)) ∧
  (∀ (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)) (Q : Fin n → Word m) (W : Finset (Fin n)),
    W.card = N → uniform n m D Q Finset.univ →
    (∀ j ∈ W, ¬ uniform n m D Q (Finset.univ.erase j)) →
    N ≤ n ∧ (∀ j ∈ W, m-1 ≤ readers n D j) ∧ N*(m-1) ≤ wires n D)
changed.unlocks: This would give the exact number of sensor read wires needed to make all possible nonzero report parities require different raw sites.
changed.context: Index sites by nonzero masks. Assign unit columns to singletons and pair columns to the next pair in cyclic order. Give each site a reader basis of its orthogonal hyperplane. Handle m=1,2 directly. Each indispensable site has a private mask. The reader equations and its own odd parity isolate that mask, forcing reader rank m-1. A network with the required uniformity and a designated site with fewer readers would refute the bound. A one-gate-smaller circuit companion cannot exist here because the term counts read wires and gives no circuit or gate budget.

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit evaluates every weighted fiber of a binary affine relation at the cost of blocked matrix multiplication
changed.statement:
∀ (a b c m t : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin a → F
  let Y := Fin b → F
  let Z := Fin c → F
  let N := a+b+c
  let w := max a (max b c)
  let inputs := m*(N+1)+(2^a+2^b)*t
  let bitsOut := a+b+2*t+1
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (answer : Fin (2^c) → Fin bitsOut → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
    C.output = (answer 0 0).val ∧ C.size ≤ 2^60*(N+m+t+4)^30*2^(w % 2)*7^(w/2) ∧
    ∀ (H : Fin m → X × Y × Z) (rhs : Fin m → F)
      (f : Fin (2^a) → Fin (2^t)) (g : Fin (2^b) → Fin (2^t)),
      let pack := fun (s : Nat) (v : Fin s → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin s => decide (v j ≠ 0))
      let bits := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun i =>
        pack a (H i).1 ++ pack b (H i).2.1 ++ pack c (H i).2.2 ++ [decide (rhs i ≠ 0)]) ++
        (List.finRange (2^a)).flatMap (fun ix => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (f ix).val.testBit j.val)) ++
        (List.finRange (2^b)).flatMap (fun iy => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (g iy).val.testBit j.val))
      let decode := fun (s v : Nat) (j : Fin s) => (if v.testBit j.val then 1 else 0 : F)
      let readWire := fun n : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD n.val false
      let total := fun iz : Fin (2^c) =>
        ∑ ix : Fin (2^a), ∑ iy : Fin (2^b),
          if ∀ i, dotProduct (H i).1 (decode a ix.val) + dotProduct (H i).2.1 (decode b iy.val) +
            dotProduct (H i).2.2 (decode c iz.val) = rhs i then (f ix).val*(g iy).val else 0
      ∀ iz j, readWire (answer iz j) = (total iz).testBit j.val
